visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with Toadette, a character with a pink mushroom cap and pigtails, driving a white kart into a green-lit mechanical corridor. The background features dark industrial towers with glowing red vents and a sky filled with orange smoke above a lava-filled moat. The camera follows the kart from a third-person perspective. (2) As the kart moves deeper into the facility, the walls are covered with glowing green monitors, radar screens, and control panels. Toadette performs a drift, causing blue sparks and then orange flames to shoot out from the kart's wheels. Floating gold coins appear along the path, and UI elements like a timer and map are visible on the periphery. (3) The kart exits the green-lit room onto a red metallic track segment surrounded by molten lava and volcanic rock formations. A large mechanical Bowser head and factory chimneys are visible in the distance. Toadette performs a spinning stunt in mid-air off a ramp before landing smoothly on the textured metal flooring, with the lighting shifting from neon green to a warm, fire-reflected orange.
